scope: Reused 20 unchanged Mendocino source fingerprints after a fresh complete collection; directly reviewed CDFW Double Cone Rock, Vizcaino Rock and MacKerricher access text for the Shelter Cove–Fort Bragg rectangle. Exact current geometry, seasons, charts and launch remain separate.

rules-gear.note: Reviewed 2026 CDFW general finfish gear text: lingcod and rockfish aboard impose one-line/two-hook limits; salmon gear is separately restricted.

rules-invertebrates.note: Reviewed current CDFW section 29.80 gear text for recreational crab traps, hoop nets, snares, marking and tending; gear permission is separate from season status.

rules-whales.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026–27 whale-safe status: recreational Dungeness season is presently closed, and November trap authorization needs the later zone declaration.

rules-health.note: Reviewed CDFW fishery-health notices and Mendocino-related advisories; no health page was treated as an automatic future crab or finfish clearance.

rules-ocean.note: Reviewed the 2026 CDFW ocean index and links to species, in-season and health rules; the index alone grants no location-specific permission.

rules-groundfish.note: Reviewed June 2026 CDFW groundfish summary: Mendocino boat season Apr–Dec all depths, RCG ten with two vermilion/sunset here, lingcod two at 22 inches and descending device.

rules-inseason.note: Reviewed dated CDFW in-season actions through September 11, including the Fort Bragg August salmon closure and Fishing Zone 3 recreational trap restriction; future openings need new review.

rules-salmon.note: Reviewed CDFW 2026 salmon page: the September fall season starts south of 38°02′ N, not in the Fort Bragg Management Area; north-of-Point-Conception barbless gear rules remain relevant.

rules-crab.note: Reviewed CDFW permanent redirect to the canonical crab page and its September 24 recreational regulations and FAQ. The normalized content hash matches the previously reviewed source; current season, gear, whale and health checks remain separate.

rules-book.note: Reviewed original 2026 CDFW ocean booklet: California halibut two fish north of Point Sur, albacore 25 north of Point Conception, crab limits and gear, and the §27.65 fillet rule limited to south of Point Arena.

rules-proposals.note: Reviewed 2026 Fish and Game Commission rulemaking index: groundfish conformance is proposed without an operative effective date in this packet and was not treated as current law.

rules-tuna-federal.note: Reviewed original current eCFR 50 CFR 660.721 section: 25 albacore north of Point Conception, ten if a trip enters the southern EEZ, and trip/day possession constraints.

rules-salmon-pdf.note: Reviewed original August 19 CDFW salmon flyer: Fort Bragg August 10–31 closure, no fall season north of 38°02′ N, and salmon rod/hook restrictions.

rules-groundfish-pdf.note: Reviewed original 2026 Mendocino groundfish PDF: Apr–Dec all-depth boat season, ten RCG with one copper/two canary/two vermilion-sunset, two lingcod at 22 inches, no-retention species and descending device.

rules-pacific-halibut.note: Reviewed current CDFW Pacific halibut page: north of Point Arena open Apr 1–Nov 15 or quota closure, one fish with no minimum size and one-line/two-hook angling rule.

rules-mendocino.note: Reviewed CDFW Mendocino regional page updated August 10: Fort Bragg salmon closed rest of 2026, Dungeness closed with scheduled Nov 7 opener, California and Pacific halibut distinct, and local bounds.

mpa-russian-gulch.note: Reviewed CDFW Russian Gulch SMCA page: recreational take is allowed under current rules, though SkipperCast conservatively excludes the MPA from target geometry and exports.

mpa-point-arena.note: Reviewed CDFW Point Arena and Sea Lion Cove MPA page: SMR no take, Point Arena SMCA salmon trolling only, Sea Lion Cove SMCA finfish exception; app still excludes all mapped MPA targets.

mpa-big-flat.note: Inspected CDFW Big Flat SMCA text and coordinates: ordinary recreational take is prohibited except salmon trolling and Dungeness by trap, hoop net or hand; tribal exemptions are separately listed. The app conservatively excludes all mapped MPA areas from targets and exports.

mpa-ten-mile.note: Inspected CDFW Ten Mile SMR, Ten Mile Beach SMCA and Ten Mile Estuary SMCA text and coordinates: SMR no take, Beach recreational Dungeness by trap/hoop net/hand, Estuary waterfowl only; listed tribal exemptions are separate. The app excludes all three mapped areas from targets and exports.

mpa-double-cone.note: Inspected CDFW Double Cone Rock SMCA regulations and published coordinates. Ordinary recreational take is limited to salmon by trolling and Dungeness by trap, hoop net or hand, with separate tribal exemptions. App target/export geometry excludes the whole mapped SMCA.

closure-vizcaino-rock.note: Inspected CDFW Vizcaino Rock special-closure text and coordinates. Entry is barred March 1 through August 31 within the specified 300 ft shoreline buffer, except listed official duties or CDFW permission. The app conservatively excludes this mapped closure year-round from targets and exports.

mpa-mackerricher.note: Inspected CDFW MacKerricher SMCA regulations and published coordinates. Commercial and recreational take follows current general rules, with a commercial kelp prohibition. App target/export geometry excludes this mapped SMCA despite the recreational exception.
